            d - r[ii] - r[jj],

        p = z[:2 * n].reshape(n, 2)

        d = np.sqrt(np.sum(dxy * dxy, axis=1))

        q = np.arange(n)

        jac[q, 2 * q] = 1.0
        jac[q, 2 * n + q] = -1.0
        jac[n + q, 2 * q] = -1.0
        jac[n + q, 2 * n + q] = -1.0
        jac[2 * n + q, 2 * q + 1] = 1.0
        jac[2 * n + q, 2 * n + q] = -1.0
